about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/eval, the check-time evaluator (L7). Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/eval; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it. Seeded by unit EV1 (wf10 l7-eval, 2026-11-10).

mutants.name: lf6-corpus-unreplayed
mutants.rule: A licence run takes the law's corpus cases first.

mutants.name: lf6-licence-float-by-go-equality
mutants.rule: A licence run compares a rewrite law's sides by key equality, not by the law's ==: a float law whose sides agree at a NaN holds.

mutants.name: lf6-second-run-same-state
mutants.rule: Each side of a licence run's case runs a second time under another working directory, environment and time zone.

mutants.name: lf6-edges-after-draws-only-float
mutants.rule: A licence run takes a NaN before it draws (a drawn float is finite).

mutants.name: lf6-edges-after-draws-only-content
mutants.rule: A licence run takes a string that ends inside a rune before it draws.

mutants.name: lf6-edges-after-draws-only-length
mutants.rule: A licence run takes a string of 4,096 bytes and more before it draws (a drawn string has at most 25 units).

mutants.name: lf6-vacuous-case-counted
mutants.rule: A class is reached only by a case that held, not by one that ran out of budget.

mutants.name: lf6-missed-class-licenses
mutants.rule: A licence run that did not reach every class is tested, never validated.

mutants.name: lf6-skipped-run-licenses
mutants.rule: A licence run with a skipped case is skipped and licenses nothing: a law the evaluator skips is no licence.

mutants.name: ps2-branch-on-term-continues
mutants.rule: A symbolic run stops at a term in any position but a binding, an argument, a result, a part or a concatenation: a branch on a symbol proves nothing.

mutants.name: ps2-concat-commutes
mutants.rule: The concatenation normal form joins adjacent constants only: concatenation is associative, not commutative.

mutants.name: ps2-extern-args-ignored
mutants.from: return ok && a.fn == bv.fn && symEqualAll(a.args, bv.args)
mutants.rule: Two uninterpreted calls are one term only when their arguments are.

mutants.name: ps2-read-of-written-field-stale
mutants.rule: A write through a provider's cell is what every later read and the end state see.

mutants.name: ps2-stop-proved
mutants.rule: A case whose run stops is not a case that holds: anything the run cannot decide is not proved.

mutants.name: short-circuit-rhs
mutants.rule: && and || evaluate their right operand only when the left one does not decide (lower/expr.go binary).

mutants.name: int8-constant-widened
mutants.rule: An int8 value wraps at 8 bits: non-constant arithmetic wraps at its type's width (types.md, Basic types 2).

mutants.name: int8-op-widened
mutants.rule: An int8 operation wraps at 8 bits and gives an int8 (types.md, Basic types 2).

mutants.name: defect-caught
mutants.rule: A catch handles typed failures only; a defect is never caught (rows.md, Catch 6).

mutants.name: divide-by-zero-ok
mutants.rule: An integer division by zero is a defect, as Go panics on it.

mutants.name: negative-shift-ok
mutants.rule: A shift by a negative count is a defect, as Go panics on it.

mutants.name: variant-test-true
mutants.from: return r.t.Obj == tt.Obj && r.key == argsKey(tt, t.env)
mutants.rule: A type pattern matches a union value only of that variant (rows.md, Totality; a Go type switch).

mutants.name: returned-error-is-value
mutants.rule: Returning a value of an error type is a failure (types.md, Error types 2).

mutants.name: absent-fact-pure

mutants.rule: An absent footprint is not an empty one (rows.md, Footprints 2): an internal error, never a pure frame.

mutants.name: defect-continues
mutants.rule: A defect stops the run (runtime.md, Tests 3).

mutants.name: budget-shared

	in.stepsEnd = in.stepsAt + in.budget.Steps
mutants.rule: The step budget is per obligation: an incomplete obligation leaves the whole budget to the next one (docs/testing.md, Budgets; ORACLE O22 replaces the L7 plan's per-request budget).

mutants.name: fuel-ignored
mutants.rule: Every evaluated node costs steps before its work, so a loop that never ends exhausts the budget (L7 plan, section 5).

mutants.name: skip-as-pass
mutants.rule: A skipped law is never a pass (runtime.md, Tests 7; L7 plan, section 5).

mutants.name: reseed-per-case
mutants.rule: Cases advance one binding-local stream; starting a case does not reseed it.

mutants.rule: The binding's checked conversion selects its method; short names from another package cannot replace it.

mutants.rule: Every generator draw and sized string allocation consumes work before it happens.

mutants.name: slice-write-shared
mutants.rule: A write through one binding never changes another binding's slice or array (Bindings 1).

mutants.name: map-write-shared
mutants.rule: A Map's index write, Put and Delete change only their root (Bindings 1).

mutants.name: append-tip-owned
mutants.rule: An Append that shares its input must not grant exclusive ownership to its output (Bindings 1).

mutants.name: handover-lends-not
mutants.rule: A read that lets a part escape revokes the slot's exclusive ownership (Bindings 1).

mutants.name: recursion-depth-ignored
mutants.rule: The explicit call-depth bound stops recursion with incomplete, never pass.

mutants.name: generic-substitution-unbound
mutants.rule: A generic call's checked arguments bind the callee's type parameters, including nominal patterns (Generics).

mutants.name: machine-done-is-edge
mutants.rule: A step's Done ends the run, so it is no edge of the machine's graph (types.md, Laws 13; lower/machinelaws.go).

mutants.name: machine-initial-unchecked
mutants.rule: A generated run's first state meets a law's target too: a run reaches the state it starts in ($ExploreRuns).

mutants.name: machine-key-negative-zero
mutants.rule: A state key writes a float by its bits: -0 and 0 are two states, since a step can tell them apart (batch-15 X1 M1).

			out.Evidence = ""
mutants.rule: A search the step budget stops is incomplete, never passed or proved (plan section 5).

mutants.name: vtlaws-search-replays
mutants.rule: Check time's search holds its frontier, so a whole search steps each edge once: its step calls are the states times the signals, not that plus a replayed run per state (docs/testing.md, Budgets).

mutants.name: machine-runs-ignore-walk
mutants.rule: A generated run over a keyed, listed graph steps by the signal its walk picks among those that change the state, as the test build's run does ($ExploreRuns), so both find the same run.

mutants.name: machine-proof-text-edges
mutants.rule: A whole search's report names the states, edges and depth the test build names for the same law ($ExploreAll).

mutants.name: eval-bytes-unmetered
mutants.rule: Every value allocation is charged to the byte budget before it is made; a run that cannot pay is incomplete.

mutants.name: report-incomplete-as-passed
mutants.rule: An evaluation with an incomplete or not-run obligation never sums up as passed.

mutants.name: eval-stale-source-identity
mutants.rule: The evaluation names the revision of the text it ran on, a package folder's too.

mutants.name: b16d-eval-float-int-wraps
mutants.rule: Check time converts a float to an integer by the lowering's one rule (S-conv: truncate, saturate, NaN to 0), so its verdict agrees with the Go build's.

mutants.name: try1-eval-cover-ignored
mutants.rule: grammar.md Expressions 1 (q105): the failure of an operand that a try on its left covers leaves the frame, as under the try itself; a catch around the call it is an argument of does not take it.

mutants.name: oracle-o18-json-html-ignored

mutants.name: oracle-o18-json-pair-split

mutants.name: oracle-o18-json-path-index
mutants.rule: std json Path names a list element by its index from 0 (hosts[2].port).

mutants.name: oracle-o18-json-depth-one-more

mutants.name: oracle-o18-json-tag-any-kind

mutants.rule: types.md Codecs 8: a missing key of an omittable field decodes to the empty variant.

mutants.name: oracle-o18-codec-long-tuple
mutants.rule: A tuple decodes from a list of exactly its length; a longer one fails WireWrongKind.

mutants.name: oracle-o18-codec-int8-unbounded-above
mutants.rule: types.md Codecs 3: an integer outside its type's range fails WireWrongKind.

mutants.name: oracle-o19-recovered-hosts-closed
mutants.rule: runtime.md Machines and actors 16.1/17: the recovered actor's first entry binds each host its first state holds.

mutants.name: oracle-o19-save-skipped

mutants.name: oracle-o20-round-to-even
mutants.rule: std math Round is the nearest integer, half away from zero.

mutants.name: oracle-o22-slice-reads-all

mutants.name: oracle-o22-prefix-reads-all
mutants.rule: A prefix test reads the prefix's bytes, not the whole text (docs/testing.md, Budgets).

mutants.name: oracle-o22-slice-allocates
mutants.rule: A substring is a view of its text: it allocates no value bytes.

mutants.name: oracle-o23-default-port
mutants.rule: A network policy's origin drops its scheme's default port (std http, NewNet).

mutants.name: oracle-o23-host-case
mutants.rule: A network policy compares a host name in lower case.

mutants.name: oracle-o23-refused-allowed
mutants.rule: A fetch whose origin the policy does not list fails OriginRefused before any exchange.

mutants.name: oracle-o23-limits
mutants.rule: Every limit of http.Limits must be positive: zero is InvalidLimits.

mutants.name: oracle-o23-listen-text
mutants.rule: ListenFailed's Reason is Go's net.Listen error text.

mutants.name: oracle-o26-response-header-dropped

mutants.name: oracle-o27-toml-dotted-reopens-header

mutants.name: oracle-o27-toml-multiline-quotes-lost

mutants.name: oracle-o28-host-dotdot-lexical

mutants.name: oracle-o20-go-float-is-exp

mutants.name: oracle-o30-record-key-by-identity

mutants.name: oracle-o30-ranged-key-is-text

mutants.name: oracle-o32-boxed-int-off-by-one

mutants.name: oracle-o32-int-fast-path-sub

mutants.rule: Go's append(out, s...) at check time appends each byte in place and counts it, as Append does.

mutants.name: evbuilder-appendfrom-whole-run
mutants.rule: WriteFrom's byte k is the byte at start+k of the result, so a run past the end repeats what the call wrote.

mutants.name: evbuilder-appendfrom-end-start
mutants.rule: WriteFrom from the text's end with n > 0 is Go's index panic, a defect.

mutants.name: evbuilder-appendbytes-drops-first
mutants.rule: WriteBytes adds every byte of bs.
